name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Raspberry Peach
description: Indulge in the perfect balance of tart and sweet with Double-Stacked Raspberry Peach BITEZ. Two juicy layers pair tangy raspberry with ripe, sweet peach for a bright, fruity flavor that hits the sweet spot with every chew. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A juicy fruit pairing with serious potency packed inside.
